title: Marshmallow Nougat
description: A chewy, festive nougat made by melting marshmallows with butter and milk powder, then folding in biscuits and mixed nuts — a modern Raya confection.
description_ms: Nougat yang chewy dan moden dibuat dengan mencairkan marshmallow bersama butter dan susu tepung, kemudian dilipat bersama biskut dan kacang campuran — kuih raya moden.
steps: Melt 3 tbsp butter in a non-stick wok over the lowest heat.
Add 500 g marshmallows; stir slowly and patiently until completely melted.
Stir in 0.5 cup milk powder and 0.5 tsp salt until combined.
Add biscuits (broken), cashews, almonds, raisins and/or dates gradually — fold in gently so the mixture doesn't become too firm.
Line a tray with baking paper dusted with milk powder; pour in the mixture.
Press down firmly using your hands (and a top sheet of baking paper); compact as densely as possible.
Leave at room temperature for several hours until fully set.
Dust the top with milk powder; cut into pieces to serve.
steps_ms: Cairkan 3 sudu besar butter dalam kuali non-stick atas api paling kecil.
Masukkan 500g marshmallow; kacau perlahan-lahan dengan sabar sehingga cair sepenuhnya.
Gaul masuk setengah cawan susu tepung dan setengah sudu kecil garam sehingga sebati.
Masukkan biskut (dipatah-patah), kacang gajus, badam, kismis dan/atau kurma secara beransur — lipat perlahan supaya adunan tidak terlalu keras.
Alaskan dulang dengan kertas pembakar yang ditaburi susu tepung; tuangkan adunan.
Tekan padat dengan tangan (boleh guna kertas pembakar di atas sebagai lapisan); padatkan sebanyak mungkin.
Biarkan di suhu bilik beberapa jam sehingga betul-betul keras.
Taburi susu tepung di atas; potong kepada kepingan untuk dihidang.
